# Siqi Liu

> Personal website of Siqi Liu (Yosgi). This site contains bilingual technical writing, project notes, and professional profile information. The strongest subject areas are software engineering, frontend architecture, digital twin systems, web performance, and AI tooling.

Use the English pages when a language-neutral answer is preferred. Chinese pages include both translations and original Chinese writing.

## Profile

- [English home](https://siqi-liu.com/en/): Main landing page for the site
- [About](https://siqi-liu.com/en/about/): Background, focus areas, and contact details
- [Contact](https://siqi-liu.com/en/contact/): Direct contact links
- [Chinese home](https://siqi-liu.com/zh/): Chinese landing page

- [From Extracting Drawing Text to Placing 2D Annotations in a 3D Scene](https://siqi-liu.com/en/post/from-extracting-drawing-text-to-placing-2d-annotations-in-a-3d-scene/): Connecting 2D drawing data to 3D annotation workflows
